cases.input: A monitoring alert fires without an authorized declaration.
cases.expect: Observation and alert remain; no incident identity is minted.

cases.input: Three service incidents reference one persistent problem.
cases.expect: Four distinct identities remain and closing incidents does not close the problem.

cases.input: Rollback restores service while the suspected defect remains.
cases.expect: restoredAt is recorded; problem and defect remain open.

cases.input: One outage also qualifies as a cyber incident.
cases.expect: Operational and cyber records correlate but do not merge.

cases.input: Severity changes after new impact evidence.
cases.expect: A superseding assessment is appended; the earlier assessment remains.

cases.input: Potential customer impact is later verified as actual.
cases.expect: Separate revisioned impact assertions preserve both conclusions and evidence.

cases.input: Incident closes while permanent remediation task is unfinished.
cases.expect: Incident closure does not complete the task, problem or defect.
